upstream.name: sqlite/sqlite
upstream.architecture: SQLite database file format, b-tree pages, records, varints, journaling, SQL engine, extensions, and TCL/C regression harnesses.

benchmarkDenominator.source: Shallow blobless GitHub mirror clone at .upstream-cache/libsqlite; counted with git ls-tree without hydrating broad blobs, with focused b-tree/schema path categories counted from the tree inventory.

runnerStatus.reason: The upstream runner was inventoried but not executed: this environment cannot find tclsh, cc, or make on PATH and has no Tcl headers under /usr/include. SQLite's documented test flow requires configuring/building testfixture/sqlite3 with Tcl development libraries, then running testrunner.tcl suites such as full/all that cover thousands of TCL scripts and many permutations. The defensible denominator here is the cloned static file/script inventory, not upstream pass parity.

benchmarkDenominator.warning: This denominator counts upstream test files, helper programs, and declared suites, not individual do_test assertions. PHP progress is local mapped behavior only.

nativeImplementation.currentSlice: Native SQLite database header parser, SQLite varint decoder, b-tree page header parser, table leaf and table interior cell parsers, SQLite record serial decoder, database page reader, and sqlite_schema table-b-tree traversal for WordPress table root discovery.

wordpressScenario: SQLite fallback/read-write inspection tooling for WordPress hosts where the SQLite extension is unavailable.
nextTask: Read bounded wp_options table leaf rows from resolved root pages, including option_name/option_value records, while marking overflow payload handling as unsupported until ported.
